label: defect
provenance: Self-contained synthetic fixture authored for V4.3. New holdout family, separate from the earlier development motifs. Only deterministic behavior validation, no live model tuning.

defects.claim: A string prefix accepts a sibling directory whose name begins with data.
accepted_descriptions: A string prefix accepts a sibling directory whose name begins with data.
rejected_descriptions: The safe variant permits ../ traversal despite its alphanumeric-only resolver.

expectation.rationale: Paths are purely lexical POSIX paths; filesystem links and I/O are not part of this policy. resolve_name permits normalized parent traversal, so component containment is necessary.
false_positive_traps: The safe variant permits ../ traversal despite its alphanumeric-only resolver.
